# Vendored frontend dependencies

These files are committed verbatim from the upstream npm package distributions.
They are not generated, modified, or rebuilt by this project.

## @dagrejs/dagre 1.1.4

- File: `dagre.min.js`
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@dagrejs/dagre@1.1.4/dist/dagre.min.js (npm `@dagrejs/dagre@1.1.4`, `dist/dagre.min.js`)
- Project: https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre
- License: MIT

> **Note on the package name.** This is the **scoped** `@dagrejs/dagre` package — the post-2023 lodash-free rewrite maintained by the dagrejs org. The bare unscoped `dagre` package on npm is a **different and abandoned** package (latest `0.8.5`, by Chris Pettitt, depends on lodash). When upgrading, do not confuse the two: stay on the scoped name.
